checked_classes: ordering errors — dependencies for lifecycle closeout, OpenSpec archive before reflection, and independent Windows/Apple platform branches are explicitly ordered; shared preparation gates platform branches without serializing one behind the other

missing dependencies — each goal area is covered by concrete tasks: UAR storage/discovery, dedicated settings/schema/i18n, operations/logs, Compass drift/indexing, liter-llm providers/roles, build/publish, installed acceptances, certification/archive/reflection
untestable or ambiguous acceptance criteria — gate criteria specify real integration evidence and concrete scenarios rather than generic correctness claims

scope smuggling — listed work maps to stated goals, prior analysis reuse decisions, or mandatory lifecycle/release obligations; no unrelated new daemon/framework/network-scan/unit-loop work is introduced

constraint violations — the plan preserves external installs/secrets/unrelated work, avoids unit/per-edit test loops and new daemons, requires both customer platforms and both installed acceptances, and separates implementation tasks from mandatory closeout
